summary: Next.js app (via Fumadocs) that renders the Barkpark JS SDK documentation site — MDX content pages with ToC, a landing page, and a built-in full-text search endpoint.

intentions.title: Surface JS SDK documentation to developers
intentions.evidence: page.tsx renders MDX pages from a content source with title/description/ToC; home/page.tsx funnels users to /docs/getting-started; layout.config.tsx brands the nav 'Barkpark'

intentions.title: Provide searchable docs without a third-party search service
intentions.evidence: api/search/route.ts uses fumadocs-core createFromSource — server-side search index built from the same content source, zero external dependency

intentions.title: Static-site generation for fast, cacheable docs delivery
intentions.evidence: generateStaticParams() in page.tsx pre-renders every slug at build time; generateMetadata() emits per-page SEO metadata

intentions.title: Consistent branded navigation shell across all doc pages
intentions.evidence: layout.config.tsx sets a shared BaseLayoutProps used by both docs/layout.tsx and the home layout, ensuring uniform nav chrome
